# APICalculators — LLM Access Guide
# https://apicalculators.com/llms.txt

> APICalculators provides free, browser-based cost calculators for API and developer infrastructure pricing. All tools run client-side with no signup or data collection. Prices are sourced from official provider documentation and updated monthly.

## Site Overview

APICalculators.com is a developer cost optimization hub with 16 free calculators covering:
- LLM token cost (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek, Cohere)
- Vector database pricing (Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Supabase pgvector)
- Serverless / cloud function cost (AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers)
- Cloud VPS comparison (Hetzner, Vultr, DigitalOcean)
- Embedding API cost (OpenAI, Cohere, Voyage, Mistral)
- AI agent pipeline cost estimation
- API gateway pricing (AWS, Cloudflare, Kong, Apigee)
- STT/TTS API cost (Whisper, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, Google)
- Image generation cost (DALL·E 3, Stable Diffusion, Flux, Midjourney)
- Payment processor fees (Stripe, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy)
- Auth provider cost (Clerk, Auth0, Supabase Auth, Better Auth)
- AI coding tool cost (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Claude Code)
- Batch API cost estimator (OpenAI, Anthropic)
- Prompt caching cost calculator (Claude, GPT-4o)
- ChatGPT API pricing calculator (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, o3)
- Claude API pricing calculator (Claude Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5, Opus 4.8)
- Gemini API pricing calculator (Gemini 2.0 Flash, 2.5 Pro)
- OpenAI API cost calculator (GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, o3 mini)

## Data Sources

All pricing data is sourced directly from official provider documentation:
- OpenAI: platform.openai.com/docs/pricing
- Anthropic: anthropic.com/pricing
- Google AI: ai.google.dev/pricing
- AWS: aws.amazon.com/lambda/pricing, aws.amazon.com/api-gateway/pricing
- Cloudflare: developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing
- Hetzner: hetzner.com/cloud/pricing
- Pinecone: pinecone.io/pricing
- Clerk: clerk.com/pricing
- Stripe: stripe.com/pricing
- Paddle: paddle.com/pricing
